# Orphaned outputs

212 files moved here on 2026-08-03. **Nothing was deleted.**

Every file in this directory was produced by an earlier version of the notebooks and
**cannot be regenerated by any current code path**. They were sitting in the live
output directories alongside current results, distinguishable only by timestamp, which
made it possible to cite a superseded number by accident.

The test used: the rerun rewrote every file that current code produces, so anything in
those directories still carrying a pre-rerun modification time is by definition not
produced by current code.

| Source directory | Files | What they are |
|---|---|---|
| `tables/` | 86 | Result tables for outcomes and model labels the notebook no longer emits — `any_turbines` older variants, `Model 8E energy burden extension`, `Model 9 + charger control`, `+ pv`, `+ chargers`, `baseline`, `Model 1 baseline (CDD+HDD)`, and the six `{outcome} | lowess_gradient_metrics.csv` tables |
| `standardized_tables/` | 88 | The standardized counterparts of the same |
| `figures/generated/` | 36 | The 18 individual `{predictor}_{outcome}_lowess.png` figures and their SVGs, superseded when the LOWESS analysis was consolidated into small-multiple panels |
| `standardized_figures/` | 2 | `energy_burden_der_composite.png` / `.svg` |

## Before citing anything from here

These predate the audit fixes in `AUDIT.md`, so they were produced from a dataset in
which the housing-structure columns were entirely empty, `Model 2C` was silently
identical to `Model 1`, `Model 4R` was identical to `Model 4`, and the analysis file
carried duplicate coordinate columns and a pseudo-county for unmatched ZIPs.

Concretely, the LOWESS gradient numbers changed: `pct_bachelors_plus -> y_storage`
endpoint change was **0.6203** in the archived April tables and is **0.6074** in the
current `outputs/tables/education_lowess_small_multiples_metrics.csv`. Use the current
small-multiples metrics tables.

A separate, fuller snapshot of the immediately-pre-rerun state is in
`../pre-rerun-2026-08-02/`.
